github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: All records must be written in English at all times.
The commit message must be concise and descriptive, summarizing the changes made in the commit.
The commit message should follow the conventional format: <type>(<scope>): <subject>.
The <type> should be one of the following: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore.
The <scope> is optional and can be used to specify the area of the codebase affected by the changes.
The <subject> should be a brief summary of the changes made in the commit.
